predict: TracLLM is a generic context traceback framework tailored to long context LLMs (Large Language Models). It is a method or technique used for tracing back to malicious texts or identifying important texts contributing to the output of an LLM. TracLLM is designed to outperform other methods such as Shapley and LIME/Context-Cite in this context. It serves as a system or method for understanding and attributing the contributions of specific texts to the output generated by long context LLMs.
